candidate_windows.window_text: To finetune experiments for CodeFinQA, CodeTATQA, and SEC-Num, we use Adam optimizer with an initial learning rate of 2e-6. The training process takes 3 epochs with a batch size of 32. The maximum token length is set to 2048. The model is finetuned on 8 x Nvidia A100-80GB GPUs. For both finetuned and pretrained models we use greedy decoding whenever applicable.
